import ForestLocal
import Optimality01

/-! Problem-specific full-current-source-forest depth-zero/one pretest.
The executable entry point enumerates only original source edges and checks
original ForestState.agrees on the entire candidate. -/
namespace ForestPretest01
open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState
abbrev Forest := List (List Nat)

def unchanged (ss : List Tree) : Forest := ss.map leaves

def oneCuts : List Tree → List Forest
  | [] => []
  | s :: ss =>
      (Universal233.DepthOne.edges s).map
        (fun p => Universal233.DepthOne.forest s (some p) ++ unchanged ss) ++
      (oneCuts ss).map (leaves s :: ·)

def candidates (ss : List Tree) : List Forest := unchanged ss :: oneCuts ss

inductive Result where
  | refused
  | rejected
  | found (F : Forest)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def pretest01 (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) : Result :=
  if proper T ss then
    match best (additionalCost ss) (agrees T ss) (candidates ss) with
    | none => .rejected
    | some F => .found F
  else .refused

import GroupPartition

/-! Problem-local literal finite forest states. No desired reduction fields. -/
namespace ForestState
open RMAF RestrictionBridge

def labels : Option Tree → List Nat
  | none => []
  | some t => leaves t

def targetEmbeddings : Option Tree → List (List Nat) → Bool
  | none, F => F.isEmpty
  | some t, F => pairwiseEmbeddings t F

def targetAgrees : Option Tree → Tree → List Nat → Bool
  | none, _, _ => false
  | some t, s, B => restrictionAgrees t s B

def proper (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) : Bool :=
  decide (labels T).Nodup && partitionCheck (labels T) (ss.map leaves)

def sourceCheck (T : Option Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (s : Tree) : Bool :=
  let G := family (leaves s) F
  partitionCheck (leaves s) G && G.all (targetAgrees T s) && pairwiseEmbeddings s G

def agrees (T : Option Tree) (ss : List Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) : Bool :=
  proper T ss && partitionCheck (labels T) F &&
  F.all (fun B => ss.any (fun s => contained B (leaves s))) &&
  targetEmbeddings T F && ss.all (sourceCheck T F)

def additionalCost (ss : List Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) := F.length - ss.length

import CoreGraph

/-! One-shot original-edge depth-zero/one pretest. The executable routine never
enumerates assignments, set partitions, colors, or production core outputs. -/
namespace Universal233.DepthOne
open RMAF CoreGraph

def vertices : Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf _ => [[]]
  | .node l r => [] :: ((vertices l).map (false :: ·) ++ (vertices r).map (true :: ·))

def edges : Tree → List Vertex
  | .leaf _ => []
  | .node l r => (vertices l).map (false :: ·) ++ (vertices r).map (true :: ·)

def subtreeLabels (S : Tree) (p : Vertex) : List Nat :=
  match subtree S p with
  | none => []
  | some s => leaves s

def complement (S : Tree) (p : Vertex) : List Nat :=
  (leaves S).filter (fun x => !(subtreeLabels S p).contains x)

def forest (S : Tree) : Option Vertex → List (List Nat)
  | none => [leaves S]
  | some p => [subtreeLabels S p,complement S p]

import ForestPretest01

namespace ForestPretest01
open RMAF RestrictionBridge ForestState

/-- Exactly finite compositions of inner-label and outer-block permutations.
No desired coverage, agreement or minimum field is present. -/
inductive ForestPerm : Forest → Forest → Prop where
  | nil : ForestPerm [] []
  | cons {A B : List Nat} {F G : Forest} : A.Perm B → ForestPerm F G → ForestPerm (A::F) (B::G)
  | outer {F G : Forest} : F.Perm G → ForestPerm F G
  | append {F G H I : Forest} : ForestPerm F G → ForestPerm H I → ForestPerm (F++H) (G++I)
  | trans {F G H : Forest} : ForestPerm F G → ForestPerm G H → ForestPerm F H

def best {α : Type} (cost : α → Nat) (valid : α → Bool) : List α → Option α
  | [] => none
  | a :: as =>
      if valid a then
        match best cost valid as with
        | none => some a
        | some b => if cost a ≤ cost b then some a else some b
      else best cost valid as
